name: Anguix (Spain)
description: Square green flag with a yellow wavy stripe above and a white wavy stripe below, charged at the centre with the crowned municipal arms of Anguix (a star, a snake, a cross and grapes on green).
history: Municipal flag of Anguix; Spanish municipal flags are approved by the municipal council and the autonomous community and published in the regional official gazette.

features.role: Anguix arms — star, snake, cross and grapes
